By [Xena Studios](https://xenastudios.co). Each does one job, costs next to nothing to run, and lets you switch off what you don't use. Every setting applies on reload, apart from some plugins' database settings, and old configs carry forward on update.

All eleven need Paper 1.21.11+ and Java 21+. xUtilities, zChat, xRewind, xTeleport, xVote, xBans, xMoney, xStats and xBackup also run on Folia. Download them from [GitHub](https://github.com/xena-studios/plugins/releases), and xUtilities, zChat and xLimbo from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/organization/xena-studios) too; the [docs](https://plugins.xenastudios.co) cover setup, commands, permissions and config.

## Building

Needs JDK 21 or newer.

```sh
./gradlew build                  # every plugin, tested, into <plugin>/build/libs/
./gradlew :<plugin>:runServer    # a Paper server with that plugin
```

## Contributing

Bugs and ideas go in an [issue](https://github.com/xena-studios/plugins/issues/new/choose). Security problems go privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) describes. For anything else, see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md).

[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) covers how the repo fits together, tests, the rules a change keeps, pull requests and releases. [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md) explains why the plugins are built the way they are, one file per decision in [decisions/](decisions/).
